entities.name: Jesse Niinimäki

entities.summary: Jesse Niinimäki is a Finnish professional ice hockey forward who is currently a free agent. He was last under contract with the Nikko Icebucks of the Asia League Ice Hockey having signed for the team on July 20, 2017, but ultimately never played for the team. Niinimäki was selected by the Edmonton Oilers in the first round, 15th overall, of the 2002 NHL Entry Draft.
